I answered Hollis in #central-team. The only deadline on record for the signed Tansley Parcel order form is 25 August. Pree posted that in #central-team on 14 October, without a year.

That date has already passed this year. On 14 October I asked Pree whether she meant next August or whether the deadline had moved, and she still hasn't replied. So I told Hollis to check with her before putting the date on the account sheet.

I can't see any account files for Tansley Parcel, so I couldn't check the date against anything else.
